games.name: Innovation Inc. Spaceship
games.desc:
Further than any man or machine has ever been, flies the futuristic Innovation Inc Spaceship. Sent centuries ago to explore the secrets of the universe, this ship holds mysteries and dangers beyond imagination. This spacecraft has the most advanced technologies, such as the ability to hyperjump faster than light and a reactor core that is an almost infinite energy source. Explore the ship, do experiments on each other, get infected, travel through space and survive on alien planets!

💥 Explode the reactor core, or save it!
🧪 Experiment on yourself and others (it might go horribly wrong)!
🧟 Become a zombie and infect your friends!
🌌 Fly through space and crash on alien planets!
🛑 Only the strongest survive. Will you make it?

👑 Private server owners get admin commands!

🖥️ Play on PC, mobile, consoles and VR

Security rules don't apply.
